It solves the hardest problem in enterprise agentic AI—delegated authority. When an AI agent performs actions on behalf of an end-customer, you cannot just hand it static credentials or blanket admin rights. The demonstration showed an ephemeral OAuth 2.1 token exchange where scopes are dynamically trimmed to the exact API method being invoked. And from an auditing standpoint, how clearly does it track the provenance of the request? Every downstream ledger transaction embeds a cryptographic assertion chain: who the human was, which AI agent was invoked, the exact prompt hash, and the timestamp. transcript: Hey! You've been inspecting the internal AI platform infrastructure stack. How is our compute backbone shaping up for all these heavy models? The throughput numbers they presented are definitely solid, Aayush, and having a standardized enterprise gateway avoids every team reinventing the wheel. If team A writes inefficient prompts with ten-thousand-token contexts for a simple search, it shouldn't degrade the compute budget for our real-time fraud models.
